findings.summary: Default wallet submission error wrapper is not recognized; actual typed node invalid status becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
productionEvidence: Installed wallet-sdk-capabilities/dist/submission/submissionService.js:31 wraps each node error with its own SubmissionError via Effect.mapError.
The same module:42 runs that Effect using Effect.runPromise.
Installed wallet-sdk-facade/dist/index.js:318 invokes this submission service and rethrows its error after revert.
Classifier unwraps only FiberFailure/Fail and then tests direct node-client TransactionInvalidError or node-client SubmissionError; neither matches the separate capabilities SubmissionError.
findings.actual: Direct real node-client error is recognized. The same error under the real capabilities SubmissionError and actual Effect.runPromise returns OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
findings.impact: The intended ordinary guarded provider route cannot establish the new node-invalid predicate even when its installed node client reports the exact matching invalid status. Existing connected tests bypass the outer production wrapper.
findings.requiredRepair: Recognize only the exact installed capabilities SubmissionError at its expected position, then validate the exact inner node-client class and submitted bytes. Preserve unknown classification for unrelated/spoofed/mismatched/extra-nested errors. Add the real wrapper to connected submission tests and refreeze.
